m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Hot, salty blood! I have a thirst!
<ITALICS>Azcal Fire Ant scampers away, leaving the Essentia for you. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You burn the Undead Compounds and add the Essentia as Tezcat Threestar instructed you. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Morganthe, the Shadow Queen, of course. But who is that with her? A harbinger of doom who feels eerily familiar. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>This Dark Servant's awakening causes the dead of Azteca to rise... restless and hungry! </ITALICS>
You saw a vision? The Shadow Queen, of course, at the heart of the mass of Hungry Dead. But she could not do it alone.
This Dark Servant you saw her awaken in the Pyramid of the Black Sun is her conduit to the most powerful Death Magic.
The Hungry Dead will not stop unless you defeat the Shadow Queen and her Dark Servant!
It's grimly amusing that it takes an apocalyptic event for Itzco to ask for my help.
However, Pacal, Zaylin and I have been in deep meditation. We need Undead Compounds from the Smoking Mirror Zombies in Cenote.
Then, you'll have to battle a ghoul, Azcal Fire Ant, to get Essentia.
Take them to the Calendar Stone in the Pyramid of White Fire, and call forth a vision! Then return to us.
Battle Smoking Mirror Zombies for Undead Compounds in Cenote. Then defeat the ghoul Azcal Fire Ant for his Essentia.
Finally, take them to the Calendar Stone in the Pyramid of White Fire, and perform a vision ritual! Then return to us.
